findings.title: Public bundle export can disclose credentials embedded in the origin URL
findings.summary: Creating and sharing a public bundle copies an origin URL's authentication-bearing userinfo, query or fragment into manifest provenance and summary output. Public graph filtering does not redact that field.
findings.affectedVersion: Confirmed current draft0.6.0 at the frozen source SHA; earlier published versions unassessed

findings.title: Restoring a historical-format bundle can install active Git metadata
findings.summary: Graph clone/fork and subgraph materialization accept policy-less bundles with owning configuration and write arbitrary non-excluded manifest entries. An attacker can install .git metadata in the new destination, enabling later native Git operations to consume attacker-selected configuration.
findings.affectedVersion: Confirmed current draft0.6.0 at the frozen source SHA; earlier published versions unassessed

findings.title: Updating a private graph file can widen its filesystem permissions
findings.summary: A routine task update replaces an existing file with a fresh inode using0666 subject to umask. An owner-only0600 file can become0644; existing ACL or ownership restrictions are not preserved by either atomic writer.
findings.affectedVersion: Confirmed current draft0.6.0 at the frozen source SHA; earlier published versions unassessed

findings.title: A concurrent directory swap can redirect contained graph operations
findings.summary: The shared containment helper checks ancestors, then passes a pathname to later opens, renames and deletes. A narrower-rights local actor who can replace an ancestor can redirect an authorized operation outside the graph; skill mirroring supplies a concrete read-to-copy disclosure path.
findings.affectedVersion: Confirmed current draft0.6.0 at the frozen source SHA; earlier published versions unassessed

findings.title: Inspecting repository config or bundle sources can block on special files
findings.summary: Configuration loading and bundle freshness verification follow repository symlinks and perform unbounded whole-file reads before adequate type/size admission. A device or FIFO target can exhaust memory or block local CLI/MCP inspection.
findings.affectedVersion: Confirmed current draft0.6.0 at the frozen source SHA; earlier published versions unassessed

findings.title: Creating a skill can copy an external file through a linked registry
findings.summary: An untrusted checkout can make registry.md a symlink to an operator-readable file. Ordinary skill creation follows the link, preserves the external text, then replaces the link with a repository-local copy.
findings.affectedVersion: Confirmed current draft0.6.0 at the frozen source SHA; earlier published versions unassessed

findings.title: Snapshot verification reports directories as valid checkpoints
findings.summary: A malformed repository checkpoint can bypass all substantive verification and receive a successful machine-readable validity receipt, despite containing no usable SQLite snapshot or manifest. This is a checkpoint-validation bypass, not external execution or attestation forgery.
findings.affectedVersion: Confirmed current draft0.6.0 at the frozen source SHA; earlier published versions unassessed

findings.title: Snapshot inspection can disclose hashes of files outside the repository
findings.summary: A malicious checkout can cause snapshot verification to read an arbitrary operator-readable external file and disclose its SHA-256 and size in the verification receipt. This does not require the external file to be a valid SQLite database. Whole-file hashing also allocates memory proportional to the external target. No remote access or native SQLite write effect is asserted.
findings.affectedVersion: Confirmed current draft0.6.0 at the frozen source SHA; earlier published versions unassessed

findings.title: Recovery journal operations are not bound to the approved upgrade plan hash
findings.summary: Resuming or recovering an upgrade compares the user-approved plan hash to a mutable journal string but does not bind the journal's operations to that hash. A replaced journal can add ordinary-file writes while retaining the approved hash.
findings.affectedVersion: Confirmed current draft0.6.0 at the frozen source SHA; earlier published versions unassessed

findings.title: Init rewrites hard-linked manifest peers outside the selected repository
findings.summary: Running init, including without --force, can overwrite another repository's hard-linked init manifest with the selected repository's generated ownership metadata. This can corrupt the external repository's upgrade provenance. The finding does not require a race, but ordinary Git cloning does not preserve the required hard link.
findings.affectedVersion: Confirmed current draft0.6.0 at the frozen source SHA; earlier published versions unassessed

findings.title: Large numeric aliases can hang repair or corrupt newly authored graph nodes
findings.summary: Graph documents can supply decimal IDs that parse correctly but exceed JavaScript's precise integer range. Legacy repair can then loop indefinitely; ordinary creation, checkpoint creation and loop forks can instead author duplicate or invalid aliases, disrupting subsequent graph operations.
findings.affectedVersion: Confirmed current draft0.6.0 at the frozen source SHA; earlier published versions unassessed

findings.title: Creating a loop can read an external file through a linked seed template
findings.summary: `new loop` automatically reads every matching loop seed after creating the node. A repository-supplied symlink can make this optional discovery read an external Markdown file and expose its title, or block on a special device, leaving the creation without its normal receipt.
findings.affectedVersion: Confirmed current draft0.6.0 at the frozen source SHA; earlier published versions unassessed

findings.title: Loop inspection can exhaust memory by reading seeds without template limits
findings.summary: Loop list, seed show, fork and provenance lookup read regular seed bodies without the configured file, aggregate or catalog limits. A supplied large seed or many seeds can stall or terminate local inspection or authoring despite the normal template safety envelope.
findings.affectedVersion: Confirmed current draft0.6.0 at the frozen source SHA; earlier published versions unassessed

findings.title: Compressing an archive can copy or overwrite another workspace's files
findings.summary: Archive compression authorizes the sidecar owner but trusts its relative payload paths within the entire repository. A root-owned sidecar can point into a nested private or disabled workspace, copy its raw data into a parent archive, or replace its graph documents with ZIP bytes without force.
findings.affectedVersion: Confirmed current draft0.6.0 at the frozen source SHA; earlier published versions unassessed
